data.summary:
Results-driven Business Analyst and Product Owner with over 8+ years of experience in retail and investment banking services, specializing in cards & payments, ISO 8583 message handling, EMV transaction management, and authorization, clearing, and settlement workflows, Demonstrates proven expertise in requirements gathering, project management and comprehensive reporting within banking and financial domains. Skilled in leading cross-functional teams across product, engineering, and support functions to deliver client-focused solutions on time. Skilled in Jira for agile delivery, consistently accelerating go-live timelines by 20-30% while mitigating risks in international payments and digital transformation. Eager to leverage domain expertise for BA roles in enterprise payments innovation.organizational efficiency throughout the product lifecycle.
Accomplishment
Collaborated with team size of 7 in the each phase of SDLC. Served as project lead on major outsourcing engagements that included managing vendor relationships, supervising junior staff. Responsible for leading testing efforts, ensuring that issues are identified, tracked, reported on,and resolved in a timely manner. Built system and process roadmaps to ensure realization and standardization of business requirements.

Experience
Capgemini Technology Private Limited Business Analyst Mar 2024 – Present | Pune, India Barclays Project Delivered high-impact projects independently in global AGILE
environments, managing parallel implementations while meeting cross-time-zone deadlines and regulatory standards.
Conducted detailed requirements gathering, user story creation,
and functional specification development, applying strong analytical mindset and attention to detail to ensure robust traceability throughout the SDLC.
Acted as a Subject Matter Expert (SME), providing in-depth domain guidance, and ensuring successful Agile delivery by participating in PI Planning, Sprint Reviews, and product retrospectives.
Leveraged cards/payments expertise, digital
transformation, advancing prepaid, debit , credit solutions with user stories, process flows, and functional specifications through Barclays Mobile App.
Verinite Technology Private Limited Business Analyst Apr 2022 – Mar 2024 | Pune, India Led integration and delivery of Merchant POS, terminal solutions and Card-on-File Tokenization projects for leading Indian Bank, demonstrating expertise in project management, stakeholder coordination, and payment platform implementation.
Delivered a Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) product for for a leading
Indian Bank on Mobile app, taking charge of end-to-end implementation, test planning, and execution in collaboration with business and technical teams.
Authored BRDs, FSDs, and change request documentation,
showcasing strong technical writing and process improvement skills while managing Agile and Waterfall methodologies
Supported all phases of the Software Testing Lifecycle including
integration, functional, database, UI, regression, and sanity testing, ensuring high-quality releases.
Artech Infosystem (Mastercard Technology) Business Analyst Sep 2021 – Apr 2022 | Pune, India Experienced in four-party model for card processing
implementations.
Managed end-to-end project delivery and customer-specific
implementation plans.
Served as primary client contact throughout processing project execution.Assessed and documented impacts on core/non-core Mastercard systems.
Acted as processing implementation advisor for clients and
support teams.
Guided execution of all implementation activities and oversaw parallel key projects (high-value customers/markets/services). Drafted process improvements and led proposals for BIN/ICA
changes, processor switches,functional testing and User Acceptance Testing.
Yalamanchili Software Export Limited Senior Business Operations Analyst Sep 2016 – Sep 2021 | Nagpur, India Delivered consumer finance and cards & payments solutions,
including deployment of the Shell Fleet Card product for a major banking client.
Conducted workload analysis and implemented process
improvements, achieving a 40% increase in productivity for Sodexo and Barclays Bank projects.
Specialized in electronic payment systems, including authorization
processing, clearing, settlement, reconciliation, disputes, chargebacks, and ISO 8583 messaging.
Monitored prepaid, debit, and credit card transactions to detect anomalies and ensure compliance with operational standards.
Facilitating smooth implementation and processing of the
operational activities. Providing operational and technological support to the client with regard to the software services.
